alternate_names: Prachin Shiv Mandir Gagan Ji Ka Tilla

history.period: Ancient, date unverified; claimed among the oldest Shiva temples in Punjab - UNVERIFIED
history.summary: Known locally as the Prachin Shiv Mandir, this ancient Shiva temple stands atop a hill (tilla) near village Sahora Kandi in the Kandi foothills; the temple's own community claims it is among the oldest Shiva mandirs in Punjab, with more than 750 steps to the sanctum and a widely attended Mahashivratri fair. No verifiable founding date or builder is documented, so its antiquity claim is UNVERIFIED. Coordinates from two independent web listings agree to within ~0.002 degrees.

name: Gagan Ji Ka Tilla
town_description: Sahora Kandi is a village in Mukerian tehsil, Hoshiarpur district, Punjab, lying in the Kandi belt of the Shivalik foothills near Jugial. It is best known for the ancient Gagan Ji Ka Tilla Shiva temple on the hill above the village, reached by over 750 steps. The temple lies roughly 45-50 km northeast of Hoshiarpur city.

travel.airport: Adampur (~35 km, limited service - verify); Amritsar (~100 km - verify); Chandigarh (~135 km - verify).
travel.railway: Nearest stations: Dasuya/Mukerian (verify); Hoshiarpur is ~46 km away per one listing (verify).
travel.road: The temple is on Gagan Ji Da Tilla Road near Jugial, Mukerian tehsil; reached by road from Dasuya/Mukerian (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: Mahashivratri (Feb/March) for the fair; October to March for pleasant weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: CONFLICT (verify): temple's own Facebook page lists Sunday 4:00 AM-10:00 PM and Mon-Sat 4:30 AM-9:30 PM; Justdial lists daily 6:00 AM-9:00 PM.
